system.description:
The spirit conjurer flies into a furious rage, which also causes hair to grow out of their arms and crooked horns to emerge from their forehead. ✦ Mountain Ogre’s Fury grants the following:

  • Mountain Ogre’s Fury grants the
✦ +3 Body Points (damage is taken from these bonus points before normal Body Points are affected) ✦ +1 in damage with melee weapons or throwing weapons ✦ Spirit conjurer cannot parry or avoid attacks ✦ Spirit conjurer ignores all effects from fear
